Question: My sister-in-law is living in our neighbour,Her husband is a rich man,they sell all their land and amount is fixed into bank.A huge amount of interest they received monthly.I really hate them for this . food and fruits etc has exchanged between both the families.often I tell them "WAEED" accoding to Sunnah, but my wife angiry to me. Now tell me what shall I do. Should I receive any gift from them or not. Pl tell me indetail. Allah HAFIZ NJUM Answer ID: 6118 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1548/1180=H/1429) Keep on convincing your wife and sister-in-law?s family with wisdom, politeness and insight. If they give you a gift you should accept it and give it in charity to the poor and needy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
